breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the dynamic amplification from a suddenly applied load; for a linear elastic bar, the peak stress is not the same as the static stress.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction that 'peak stress is the same as the static stress P/A.' Instead, it directs the solver to use the energy method by comparing work done by the suddenly applied load to the strain energy stored in the bar. This approach naturally yields the dynamic amplification factor of 2 (σ_max = 2P/A), consistent with the ground truth prompt. The incorrect static stress equivalence is not repeated anywhere in the generated specification.
